processes:task-ge-improve-confirm-9q9heh.plain_language_description: When the outcomes pack exists, the confirmation custodian sets it beside the internal-audit method and the contract that classifies findings, reconciles the two, and issues the improvement confirmation to the custodian of governance and to the audit committee, logging it into the case file.
